paite: Kha sagihna, khaa a ni sawmnih leh khatnain, jawlnei Haggai akipanin TOUPA thu a hongtunga
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: Juda ukpipa Sialtil tapa Zerubbabel kiangah, leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Josua kiang leh, mi omsunte kiangah tuin thu genin, chiin.
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

paite: Tumaa a thupinaa hiai in mu na lak uah kua na om lai ua? huan tuin bangchibangin na mu ua? na mitmuh un bangmah lou bang ahi maw? chiin.
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

paite: Hita mahleh, Zerubbabel aw, hat takin omin, TOUPAN a chi; Josua, siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa aw, hat takin om in; nou gama mite tengteng aw, hat takin om unla, nasem un, TOUPAN a chi; na kiang ua ka om jiakin, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Aigupta gam akipan na hong pai khiak lai ua na kinag ua thu ka khuna, na lak ua ka kha a om gigedan theigige un; lau kei un.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

paite: TOUPAN lah hichiin a chi ngala; Khatvei lai, sawtlou kalin, vante leh, lei leh, tuipi leh, gam hul ka sing ding.
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

paite: Huan, nam tengteng ka sing dinga, huchiin nam tengteng thil deihte a hongtung ding, huchiin hiai in thupinain ka dimsak ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi hi.
english: and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Dangka keia ahi, dangkaeng keia ahi, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hiai in thupina nanung a masa sangin, a thupizo ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi; huan hiailai mun ah muanna ka pe ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place will I give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

paite: Daria kum nihna, a kha kua a ni sawmnih leh linain, jawlnei Haggai akipanin TOUPa thu a hongtunga.
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: Sepaihte TOUPAN hichiin ahi. Tuin dan lam thua siampute dong un
english: “Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

paite: Min a puansilh puanten ah sa siangthou lo leh, huan a puantenin tanghau Hiam, meh hiam, uain hiam, sa hiam sukhata leh a hongsiangthou diam>? chiin. Huan siamputen, li, chiin a dawn uh
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

paite: Huan Haggaiin, Misi luang jiaka mi ninin hiaite-a abangpeuh khoih leh siangin a om diam? a chi a. Huan siamputen a dawng ua, Siang louin a om ding a chi uh.
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

paite: Huan Haggaiin a dawnga, TOUPAN, Huchi bangin hiai mite, leh huchi bangin hiai nam ka maah ahi uh; huchi bangin a khutte uh nasep chteng; leh huailaia a thillat uh a siang kei hi, a chi, chiin.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

paite: Huchiin tuin, ka honngen ahi, Tunia kipan leh abanbanin, TOUA biakin-a suang a kichian main ngaihtuah un
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

paite: Tehna sawmnih kivum min a hongmuh lai, huai nite a om nung siah, sawmkhat kia a om hil bawm sawmngaa dim khe dinga min uain thau a honmuh laiin, sawmnih kia a om hi.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

paite: Na khut nasepte tengteng uah keuna leh kawtluatna leh gialin ka hon gawta; huchipiin leng kei lam na hongnga kei uh. TOUPAN a chi hi.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Ka honngen ahi tunia kipan leh abanbanin, TOUPA biakin suangphum a kiphah ni akipan, a kha kuana a ni sawmnih leh li nia kipan, ngaihtuah un,
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

paite: Pang sungah haichi a om lai hia? ahi, grepgui, theipi kung, pomgranet, oliv sing a hongsuak kei laia; tunia kipanin ka honvualjawl ding hi.
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t brought forth. From this day will I bless you.’”

paite: Khaa ni sawmnih leh ni li niin Haggai kiangah a nihveinain TOUPa thu a hongtunga
english: The Word of Yahweh came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

paite: Juda ukpipa Zerubbabel kiangah, Vante leh lei ka sing dinga
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

paite: Lalgamte laltutphah ka lumlet dinga, namte, lalgamte hatna ka suse ding kangtalaite leh, huaia tuangte ka pai ding; huchiin sakolte leh a tung ua tuangmite a hongkum ding uh, mi chih a unau namsauin, a chi, chiin thugenin.Huai ni chiangin AW Zerubbabel, ka sikha, Sialtil tapa, ka honla ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, suai bangin ka honbawl ding, TOUPAN, a chi; nang lah ka hontelta ngala, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots, and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

paite: Huai ni chiangin AW Zerubbabel, ka sikha, Sialtil tapa, ka honla ding, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi, suai bangin ka honbawl ding, TOUPAN, a chi; nang lah ka hontelta ngala, sepaihte TOUPAN a chi.
english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, will I take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”
